linux.name: Nmap Network Scanner
linux.desc: Premier network exploration, host discovery, and vulnerability scanner.

recipes.name: Stealth SYN Port Scan
recipes.desc: Scans common ports without completing the 3-way handshake (half-open scan).

recipes.name: Aggressive OS & Service Version Detection
recipes.desc: Detects daemon versions, fingerprints underlying OS, runs default scripts, and performs traceroute.

recipes.name: Comprehensive Vulnerability Engine (NSE Vuln)
recipes.desc: Executes vulnerability detection scripts against identified open service versions.

recipes.name: Subnet Live Host Discovery (Ping Sweep)
recipes.desc: Sweeps local CIDR subnet using ARP/ICMP to find active machines without port scanning.

recipes.name: Fast UDP Top Ports Audit
recipes.desc: Probes common high-risk UDP daemons (DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP).

recipes.name: SMB Share & Security Enum (SMB-Security-Mode)
recipes.desc: Checks SMB signing status, dialects, and anonymous null session share access.

linux.name: Kismet Wireless Sniffer
linux.desc: Wireless network detector, sniffer, and intrusion detection system for 802.11 and SDR.

recipes.name: Launch Kismet on Monitor Interface
recipes.desc: Starts Kismet capturing on a designated wireless monitor card with local web UI.

recipes.name: Headless Logging with Fixed Channel
recipes.desc: Locks capture interface to a single channel and logs packets to a dedicated directory.

linux.name: Aircrack-ng Suite
linux.desc: Complete suite for 802.11 wireless security auditing, monitoring, and WPA2 handshake cracking.

recipes.name: Enable Monitor Mode (airmon-ng)
recipes.desc: Kills conflicting network daemons and shifts physical wireless adapter into monitor mode.

recipes.name: Targeted Handshake Capture (airodump-ng)
recipes.desc: Locks airodump-ng onto a specific target BSSID and channel to capture the 4-way WPA2 handshake.

recipes.name: Deauthentication Attack (aireplay-ng)
recipes.desc: Sends targeted 802.11 deauth frames to force client re-association and capture handshake.

recipes.name: Dictionary Handshake Crack (aircrack-ng)
recipes.desc: Brute-forces the captured WPA2 4-way handshake using a wordlist dictionary.

linux.name: Tshark & Wireshark CLI
linux.desc: Terminal-based deep packet inspection and network protocol dissection engine.

recipes.name: Live HTTP Host & URI Sniffer
recipes.desc: Inspects outbound HTTP GET/POST traffic in real-time, extracting domain and path.

recipes.name: DNS Query Resolution Sniffer
recipes.desc: Monitors all outbound DNS query names to identify domains, beaconing, or C2 tunnels.

recipes.name: Filter Existing PCAP for Specific IP
recipes.desc: Extracts packets matching source or destination IP from a previously saved .pcap file.

linux.name: THC Hydra
linux.desc: Fast, parallelized network login brute-force tool supporting over 50 protocols.

recipes.name: SSH Parallel Brute Force
recipes.desc: Attempts SSH login across a wordlist using multiple concurrent threads.

recipes.name: FTP Brute Force with User & Pass Lists
recipes.desc: Tests combinations of users and passwords against an FTP daemon.

linux.name: Gobuster Web Fuzzer
linux.desc: High-speed URI and DNS directory/subdomain brute-forcing tool written in Go.

recipes.name: Web Directory & File Brute Force
recipes.desc: Discovers hidden files, folders, and scripts on a web server.

recipes.name: DNS Subdomain Enumeration
recipes.desc: Discovers active subdomains using dictionary lookup against a DNS server.

linux.name: Hashcat GPU Cracker
linux.desc: Advanced GPU-accelerated hash recovery and password cracking engine.

recipes.name: NTLM Hash Cracking (Mode 1000)
recipes.desc: Recovers plaintext Windows passwords from NTLM hashes using wordlist and rules.

recipes.name: WPA/WPA2 Handshake Hashcat (Mode 22000)
recipes.desc: Cracks modern PMKID / EAPOL handshakes converted into hashcat .hc22000 format.

linux.name: Metasploit & Msfvenom
linux.desc: Penetration testing framework and automated payload generation suite.

recipes.name: Generate Windows x64 Reverse Shell (Msfvenom)
recipes.desc: Creates an obfuscated 64-bit Windows executable payload connecting back to listener.

recipes.name: Quick Multi-Handler One-Liner (Msfconsole)
recipes.desc: Spawns a background Meterpreter reverse TCP handler in Metasploit.
recipes.template: msfconsole -q -x "use exploit/multi/handler; set payload windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp; set LHOST {{lhost}}; set LPORT {{lport}}; run"

linux.name: Netcat & Socat
linux.desc: The Swiss Army knife of TCP/IP networking, socket inspection, and shell piping.

recipes.name: Simple TCP Port Listener
recipes.desc: Binds a local port and prints raw incoming bytes to terminal stdout.

recipes.name: Banner Grabbing on Target Port
recipes.desc: Connects to remote daemon with timeout to extract service identification banner.

linux.name: Linux Admin & Host Defense
linux.desc: Core Linux utilities for system auditing, permissions, processes, and network sockets.

recipes.name: Audit SUID Binaries (Privilege Escalation)
recipes.desc: Scans filesystem for root-owned executables with setuid bit set.

recipes.name: Listening Endpoints with Owning PIDs (ss)
recipes.desc: Lists active TCP and UDP listening sockets without DNS name resolution delay.

recipes.name: Real-Time Auth Log Monitor (Failed SSH)
recipes.desc: Follows auth.log and highlights failed authentication attempts.

recipes.name: Inspect Service Status and Recent Logs (systemctl)
recipes.desc: Checks daemon health and displays last 30 log lines.

recipes.name: Find Files Modified in Last 24 Hours
recipes.desc: Useful for incident response triage to find recently dropped or altered files.

linux.name: PMKID & Clientless WPA2 Attack
linux.desc: Clientless WPA/WPA2 PMKID capturing suite using hcxdumptool and hcxpcapngtool.

recipes.name: Capture PMKID Hashes Headless (hcxdumptool)
recipes.desc: Captures PMKID hashes directly from access points without requiring connected client stations.

recipes.name: Convert PCAPNG to Hashcat 22000 Format
recipes.desc: Extracts captured PMKID / EAPOL hashes into Hashcat mode 22000 format.

linux.name: Chisel & Socat Network Pivots
linux.desc: Fast TCP/UDP port forwarding, relay listeners, and HTTP-encapsulated reverse tunnels.

recipes.name: Socat TCP Port Redirection Relay
recipes.desc: Listens on a local port and automatically forwards all incoming traffic to a remote host/port.

recipes.name: Chisel Reverse SOCKS5 Server
recipes.desc: Starts a Chisel reverse tunnel server waiting for remote agent callback.

recipes.name: Chisel Reverse Client Connection
recipes.desc: Connects back to Chisel server and opens an internal SOCKS5 proxy.

linux.name: Linux Privilege Escalation Hunter
linux.desc: Automated reconnaissance commands to discover misconfigurations, SUID binaries, and sudo rights.

recipes.name: Audit Current Sudo Capabilities (sudo -l)
recipes.desc: Lists available commands the current user can execute with root or other user privileges.

recipes.name: Search for Writable Files in /etc and /var
recipes.desc: Finds configuration files that can be tampered with by unprivileged users.

recipes.name: Audit Crontab and Scheduled Tasks
recipes.desc: Inspects system crontabs, user cron jobs, and systemd timers for privilege escalation vectors.

recipes.name: Check Linux Kernel Release and Architecture
recipes.desc: Dumps kernel version to quickly identify dirtycow, overlayfs, or pwnkit vulnerabilities.

linux.name: Linux Incident Response & Forensics
linux.desc: Triage commands for active user sessions, failed SSH attempts, and recently dropped files.

recipes.name: Real-Time SSH Auth Failures (tail journalctl)
recipes.desc: Streams real-time SSH brute force and failed login attempts with colored output.

recipes.name: Audit Active User Sessions and Last Logins
recipes.desc: Displays who is currently logged into the system along with recent user login history.

recipes.name: Find SUID Executables Outside Standard System Paths
recipes.desc: Flags anomalous SUID binaries placed in non-standard directories like /tmp, /dev/shm, or /opt.

recipes.name: Audit Open Network Files Correlated to Sockets (lsof)
recipes.desc: Reveals which specific process binary and user owns each open internet socket.

linux.name: Wireless Deauthentication & Rogue AP Audit
linux.desc: Targeted 802.11 management frame transmission and broadcast beacon inspection.

recipes.name: Continuous Broadcast Deauth Burst (aireplay-ng)
recipes.desc: Sends continuous 802.11 deauth frames to an access point BSSID to test client reconnection behavior.

recipes.name: Airodump Channel Hop Survey
recipes.desc: Performs wide-spectrum passive 2.4 GHz beacon and client discovery.

windows.name: Windows Package Manager (winget)
windows.desc: Native command-line package manager for automated Windows software management.

recipes.name: Search for Application by Name
recipes.desc: Searches the official Windows Package Manager repository for matching IDs.

recipes.name: Silent Install by Exact Package ID
recipes.desc: Installs an application silently, accepting all licenses without GUI prompts.

recipes.name: Upgrade All Installed Applications Silently
recipes.desc: Scans installed applications and triggers automated silent upgrades for all outdated packages.

recipes.name: Export Installed Machine Software Manifest
recipes.desc: Generates a JSON manifest of all installed software for disaster recovery / fleet cloning.

windows.name: PowerShell DFIR & Event Auditing
windows.desc: High-fidelity Windows event log hunting and forensic triage cmdlets.

recipes.name: Audit Failed Logons (Security Event 4625)
recipes.desc: Extracts failed authentication attempts with timestamps and account names.

recipes.name: Audit Interactive Logons (Security Event 4624)
recipes.desc: Surfaces successful console and RDP interactive sessions.
recipes.template: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4624} -MaxEvents {{max_events}} | Where-Object {$_.Properties[8].Value -in @(2,10)} | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -Wrap

recipes.name: Audit Defender Antivirus Exclusions (Defense Evasion)
recipes.desc: Checks Windows Defender configurations for suspicious exclusion paths or extensions.

recipes.name: Audit Process Creation Lineage (Sysmon / Event 4688)
recipes.desc: Extracts process creation events including parent PIDs and full command-line arguments.

windows.name: PowerShell Network & Sockets
windows.desc: Windows network stack inspection, active sockets, and remote connectivity testing.

recipes.name: Established TCP Sockets with Process Names
recipes.desc: Correlates active network sockets directly to local executable names.
recipes.template: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, RemoteAddress, RemotePort, OwningProcess, @{N='Process';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

recipes.name: Test Remote TCP Port Connectivity (Test-NetConnection)
recipes.desc: Tests whether a specific TCP port is reachable through firewall rules without ping.

recipes.name: Flush DNS Resolver Cache & Register
recipes.desc: Clears local DNS client cache and re-registers client name with DNS servers.

recipes.name: Complete Network Adapter & DNS IP Configuration
recipes.desc: Dumps full IPv4/IPv6, default gateways, and DNS server addresses across all connected interfaces.
recipes.template: Get-NetIPConfiguration | Format-Table InterfaceAlias, IPv4Address, IPv4DefaultGateway, DNSServer -AutoSize

recipes.name: Continuous Latency & Jitter Monitor (Test-Connection)
recipes.desc: Sends continuous ICMP probes to target host with exact millisecond latency timestamps.

windows.name: Netsh Network Shell
windows.desc: Command-line scripting utility to display or modify the network configuration of a Windows host.

recipes.name: Extract Saved Wi-Fi Password (Cleartext Key)
recipes.desc: Recovers cleartext WPA2/WPA3 pre-shared key for a saved Wi-Fi profile.
recipes.template: netsh wlan show profile name="{{ssid}}" key=clear

recipes.name: List All Stored Wi-Fi SSIDs
recipes.desc: Lists every wireless network profile currently cached on the Windows machine.

recipes.name: Configure Local Port Proxy Forwarding
recipes.desc: Forwards local incoming TCP traffic from one port to another internal or remote target.
recipes.template: netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport={{listen_port}} listenaddress=0.0.0.0 connectport={{dest_port}} connectaddress={{dest_ip}}

windows.name: Sysinternals & System Diagnostics
windows.desc: Advanced Windows diagnostic, persistence hunting, and process forensics utilities.

recipes.name: Autoruns Deep Persistence Export (CLI)
recipes.desc: Audits all auto-starting locations (Registry Run, Services, AppInit DLLs, Scheduled Tasks) to CSV.

recipes.name: Process Monitor Boot Log Setup
recipes.desc: Configures ProcMon to capture system activity during the earliest boot phases.

recipes.name: Unquoted Service Paths Vulnerability Audit
recipes.desc: PowerShell audit discovering third-party services installed with unquoted paths containing spaces.
recipes.template: Get-CimInstance win32_service | Where-Object {$_.PathName -notmatch '^"' -and $_.PathName -match '\s' -and $_.PathName -notmatch 'C:\\Windows'} | Select-Object Name, PathName, StartMode

windows.name: DISM & System File Checker (SFC)
windows.desc: Windows Component Store servicing, corruption repair, and system file integrity verification.

recipes.name: Online Component Store Health Restore
recipes.desc: Downloads verified clean system binaries from Windows Update to heal corrupted system stores.

recipes.name: System File Checker Integrity Verification
recipes.desc: Scans all protected system files and replaces corrupted files with a cached copy.

recipes.name: Offline WIM Image Repair (Rescue USB)
recipes.desc: Repairs an offline Windows installation using an install.wim file from recovery media.

windows.name: WSL2 & USB Passthrough (usbipd)
windows.desc: Manages WSL2 Linux environments and physical USB peripheral routing (SDR, Android).

recipes.name: List All Physical USB Peripherals & Bus IDs
recipes.desc: Queries Windows USB host controller to find Bus IDs for SDRs, microcontrollers, and devices.

recipes.name: Attach USB Device to WSL2 Linux
recipes.desc: Routes a physical USB device directly into the active WSL2 Kali/Ubuntu kernel.

recipes.name: Detach USB Device from WSL2
recipes.desc: Releases USB hardware from WSL2 and returns control back to the Windows host.

recipes.name: Clean Shutdown of All WSL Distros
recipes.desc: Gracefully terminates all running WSL2 virtual machines to release RAM and disk locks.

windows.name: Certutil Security Utilities
windows.desc: Certificate services CLI utility commonly used for hash verification and encoding.

recipes.name: Calculate SHA-256 File Hash
recipes.desc: Computes cryptographic SHA256 hash to verify binary integrity or match threat intel IOCs.

recipes.name: Base64 Encode a Binary File
recipes.desc: Converts binary data into ASCII base64 representation for transport or analysis.

windows.name: PowerShell System & Hardware Audit
windows.desc: Rapid hardware diagnostics, S.M.A.R.T. disk telemetry, battery health, and unquoted services.

recipes.name: Physical Disk & S.M.A.R.T. Status Audit
recipes.desc: Queries CIM storage subsystem for drive model, serial, media type (SSD/NVMe), and operational health.
recipes.template: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object DeviceId, FriendlyName, MediaType, OperationalStatus, HealthStatus, Size

recipes.name: Audit Unquoted Service Paths (Privilege Escalation)
recipes.desc: Identifies non-system32 services with spaces in the executable path lacking quotation marks.
recipes.template: Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.PathName -notmatch '^"' -and $_.PathName -match ' ' -and $_.PathName -notmatch '^C:\\Windows\\' } | Select-Object Name, PathName, StartMode, StartName

recipes.name: Detailed Battery & Power Capacity Report
recipes.desc: Generates HTML diagnostic battery telemetry report with cycle counts and degradation.

recipes.name: Dump Installed Drivers with Vendor & Date
recipes.desc: Lists third-party installed hardware drivers to identify outdated or unsigned kernel modules.
recipes.template: driverquery /FO CSV | ConvertFrom-Csv | Select-Object 'Display Name', 'Driver Type', 'Link Date' | Out-GridView

windows.name: Persistence & Autostart Hunter
windows.desc: DFIR hunting recipes for Run keys, Startup folders, WMI subscriptions, and hidden Scheduled Tasks.

recipes.name: Inspect Registry Run & RunOnce Keys
recipes.desc: Enumerates user and system autorun locations for suspicious persistence binaries.

recipes.name: Audit Non-Microsoft Scheduled Tasks
recipes.desc: Filters active scheduled tasks excluding standard Microsoft/Windows tasks to spot malware persistence.
recipes.template: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.TaskPath -notlike '\Microsoft*' } | Select-Object TaskName, TaskPath, State | Format-Table -AutoSize

recipes.name: Inspect Startup Folders (LNK Shortcuts)
recipes.desc: Checks current user and all-users startup directories for persistent script or executable shortcuts.
recipes.template: Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup", "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup" -File | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime

recipes.name: WMI Event Consumer Persistence Audit
recipes.desc: Audits stealthy WMI Event Filters and CommandLineEventConsumers commonly used by APTs.

windows.name: Active Directory & Domain Recon (PowerView / ADSI)
windows.desc: Zero-footprint Active Directory reconnaissance using native ADSI .NET classes without RSAT tools.

recipes.name: Query Domain Controllers & Primary Forest
recipes.desc: Retrieves the current domain, forest name, and active PDC emulator hostname using native .NET.

recipes.name: Enumerate Domain Admin Accounts via ADSI
recipes.desc: Searches Active Directory LDAP tree for all accounts belonging to the Domain Admins security group.

recipes.name: Audit Password Last Set & Expiration for All Users
recipes.desc: Dumps account status, password age, and bad password counts across domain or local accounts.
recipes.template: Get-LocalUser | Select-Object Name, Enabled, PasswordLastSet, PasswordExpires | Format-Table -AutoSize

recipes.name: Find Computers Running Server Operating Systems
recipes.desc: Searches AD computer objects for server distributions (Domain Controllers, SQL, Web Servers).

windows.name: Defender & Host Hardening Auditing
windows.desc: Audits Windows Defender security controls, Controlled Folder Access, and Credential Guard status.

recipes.name: Audit Windows Defender Real-Time Protection & Signatures
recipes.desc: Queries antivirus engine status, signature age, and behavioral monitoring flags.
recipes.template: Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object AntivirusEnabled, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, IoavProtectionEnabled, AntispywareSignatureAge

recipes.name: Inspect LSASS RunAsPPL Protection Status
recipes.desc: Checks if LSA Protection (Protected Process Light) is enforced to prevent credential memory dumping.

recipes.name: Audit Windows Firewall Profiles (Domain, Private, Public)
recipes.desc: Verifies firewall status and default inbound/outbound blocking behaviors across all 3 profiles.
recipes.template: Get-NetFirewallProfile | Format-Table Name, Enabled, DefaultInboundAction, DefaultOutboundAction -AutoSize

recipes.name: Check Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Shield)
recipes.desc: Inspects ransomware folder protection and lists user-whitelisted folders and executables.

windows.name: Rapid IR Live Triage & Memory Evidence
windows.desc: Extracts volatile memory evidence, loaded DLLs, USB storage history, and suspicious command lines.

recipes.name: Process Lineage & Full Command Lines (Parent-Child)
recipes.desc: Lists running processes with full CLI arguments, process ID, and parent PID.
recipes.template: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Sort-Object ProcessId | Format-Table -Wrap

recipes.name: Extract USB Storage Device Connection History
recipes.desc: Parses the Windows USBSTOR registry hive to reveal serial numbers, vendors, and device IDs of mounted USBs.

recipes.name: Inspect Hidden Alternate Data Streams (Zone.Identifier)
recipes.desc: Audits downloaded files in user directories for MOTW (Mark of the Web) Zone.Identifier streams.
recipes.template: Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads" -Recurse -Stream * | Where-Object { $_.Stream -ne ':$DATA' } | Select-Object Filename, Stream, Length

recipes.name: Dump Active Network Adapters with DHCP & DNS Leases
recipes.desc: Shows adapter MAC addresses, physical link speed, DHCP server, and current lease expiration.
recipes.template: Get-NetIPConfiguration | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPv4Address, IPv4DefaultGateway, DNSServer | Format-List
